about: Tesla Robotaxi service launches by metro, plus the earliest dated hiring signal we could source for each. Dates are as reported; 'reported-by' means the posting existed by that date (it may have gone up earlier), so lead times are minimums. Nothing here is guessed: if no credible date was found the field is null and the site says so.

signalKinds.fleet-support: A Robotaxi (or Rideshare) Fleet Support role, the same family this site tracks
signalKinds.vehicle-operator: Autopilot vehicle operator (test driver) roles. Reporting tied these to Robotaxi expansion, but they are not Robotaxi-titled, so they are shown as a hint and never used for lead time
